adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows the exception and logs a generic message without including `err`. This doesn’t break the core guest-adding flow (the booking update already happened), but it does reduce observability by hiding the failure cause from logs and callers.
